watch.summary: The creator dramatically loses his mind over a pro Valorant player pulling off an insanely accurate sliding headshot.

beats.what: Creator hypes up the match footage while watching pro Valorant gameplay.
Player Cryo slides around the corner and instantly headshots the enemy.
Creator leaps back in his chair screaming for officials to check the player's computer.
Creator points aggressively at the camera, ranting about impossible slide accuracy.
Creator continues cackling in utter disbelief.

watch.author: creator
watch.why: The streamer's high-energy overreaction and funny accusation that the player is cheating amplify an already insane esports highlight. His physical reaction carries the humor cleanly even for non-gamers.
